eval: localStorage.setItem('catchTheWolf.save', JSON.stringify({version:2,pelts:0,streak:0,runSeed:77,seenHowTo:true,shopPromptShown:true,farm:[{uid:1,breed:'white',name:'A',x:0.3,y:0.4},{uid:2,breed:'lilac',name:'B',x:0.6,y:0.6},{uid:3,breed:'lamb',name:'C',x:0.5,y:0.3}],settings:{sound:false}})); location.hash='title'; location.reload(); 1

(async()=>{const R=await import('./js/game/rules.js'); const per=R.roundsPerDay(); let bad=0; for(let seed=1;seed<200;seed++) for(let day=0;day<8;day++){ const k={hungry:0,pack:0}; for(let i=0;i<per;i++){ const sp=R.specialRound(day*per+i,seed); if(sp) k[sp]++; } if(k.hungry!==1||k.pack!==1) bad++; } return {test:'each day has exactly one hungry round and one wolf pack', bad, ok: bad===0}})()

(async()=>{const R=await import('./js/game/rules.js'); let ok=true, sizes=[]; for(const st of [0,18,80,170]){ for(let i=0;i<200;i++){ const r=R.makeRound(st,{pack:true,maxSheep:24}); const w=r.sheep.filter(x=>x.isWolf), n=r.sheep.length-w.length; if(w.length<4||w.length>8||n<2||w.some(x=>!x.tell||!x.look.tells)) ok=false; if(i===0) sizes.push(w.length+'w/'+n+'s'); } } return {test:'pack rounds: 4 to 8 wolves, each with its own slip', sizes, ok}})()

(async()=>{const R=await import('./js/game/rules.js'); const d=ctw.save.data; let ps=-1; for(let i=0;i<R.roundsPerDay();i++) if(R.specialRound(i,d.runSeed)==='pack') ps=i; d.streak=ps; d.pelts=0; delete d.round; ctw.go('play'); window._ps=ps; return {packStreak:ps}})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const n=s.disguised().length; const label=document.querySelector('[data-tier]').textContent; return {test:'pack round starts with a banner and a wolves-left counter', n, label, ok: s.round.pack && n>=4 && /left/.test(label)}})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const d=ctw.save.data; const ws=s.disguised(); const w=ws[0]; s.pointer({type:'down',x:w.x,y:w.y,id:1}); return {test:'catching one pack wolf pays, but the streak waits', left:s.disguised().length, pelts:d.pelts, streak:d.streak, phase:s.phase, saved:d.round.sheep.filter(x=>x.isWolf).length, ok: s.disguised().length===ws.length-1 && d.pelts>0 && d.streak===_ps && s.phase==='hunt' && d.round.sheep.filter(x=>x.isWolf).length===ws.length-1}})()

(()=>{const left=ctw.scene.disguised().length; ctw.go('title'); ctw.go('play'); const s=ctw.scene; return {test:'a half-caught pack persists', before:left, after:s.disguised().length, ok: s.round.pack && s.disguised().length===left}})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const d=ctw.save.data; let guard=0; while(s.disguised().length && guard++<10){ const w=s.disguised()[0]; s.choose(w); } return {test:'catching the last wolf clears the pack and moves the streak', streak:d.streak, phase:s.phase, ok: d.streak===_ps+1 && s.phase==='reveal'}})()
(()=>{const d=ctw.save.data; d.streak=_ps; d.pelts=9; delete d.round; ctw.go('play'); return 'pack again'})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const n=s.sheep.find(x=>!x.isWolf); const hiding=s.disguised().length; s.choose(n); return {test:'a miss in a pack rings every wolf', rings:s.ring?.list.length, hiding, ok: s.ring?.list.length===hiding && ctw.save.data.pelts===0}})()

(()=>{document.querySelector('[data-again]')?.click(); const d=ctw.save.data; d.streak=1; const look={wool:'cream',face:'cream',breed:'white'}; d.round={streak:1,tellId:'tintStrong',tierIndex:0,hinted:false,weather:'clear',elapsed:0,sheep:[{look},{look},{look},{look:{...look,wolfFur:'grey',tells:{tint:40}},isWolf:true}]}; ctw.go('play'); return 'colour round'})()
(()=>({test:'a colour-wolf round shows a wool hint', banner:document.querySelector('.banner')?.textContent, ok: /wool/i.test(document.querySelector('.banner')?.textContent||'')}))()

(async()=>{const P=await import('./js/art/palette.js'); const R=await import('./js/game/rules.js'); const out={}; for(const t of R.db.tells.filter(t=>t.tells.tint)){ out[t.id]=Math.round(P.colorDistance(P.WOOL.cream.base, P.tintPalette(P.WOOL.cream,t.tells.tint).base)); } return {test:'fake wool is a bigger shift than before (faintest at least 15)', out, ok: Math.min(...Object.values(out))>=15}})()
(()=>{const d=ctw.save.data; d.streak=49; delete d.round; d.shopPromptShown=true; ctw.go('play'); return 'streak 49'})()
(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; s.disguised().forEach(w=>s.choose(w)); return {streak:ctw.save.data.streak}})()

(()=>{const p=document.querySelector('.scrim [data-farm]'); const img=document.querySelector('.scrim img.tellcard'); return {test:'streak 50 brings up the farm popup with a picture', panel:!!p, img: !!img && img.naturalWidth>0, ok: !!p && !!img && img.naturalWidth>0}})()

(()=>{document.querySelector('.scrim [data-go]').click(); const d=ctw.save.data; d.streak=15; delete d.round; ctw.go('play'); const L=ctw.scene.cal.time.light; return {test:'torch rounds grade the ground as night', night:L.night, ok: !!L.night && ctw.scene.torchMode()}})()
(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; s.torchPos={x:innerWidth/2,y:innerHeight/2}; return 'torch'})()
(()=>{ctw.go('bonus'); return 'stampede'})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const w=s.wolves[0]; const back=w.trail[0]; const before=s.caught; const bx=back.x - Math.sin(back.heading)*30*s.scale, by=back.y + Math.cos(back.heading)*30*s.scale; s.pointer({type:'down',x:bx,y:by,id:3}); return {test:'a tap on where a wolf just was (near its tail) still counts', moved:Math.round(Math.hypot(w.x-bx,w.y-by)), caught:s.caught-before, ok: s.caught===before+1}})()
(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const before=s.caught; s.pointer({type:'down',x:5,y:5,id:4}); return {test:'a tap on empty grass catches nothing', ok: s.caught===before}})()
(()=>{document.querySelector('.scrim [data-go]')?.click(); ctw.go('farm'); return 'farm'})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const lamb=s.sheep.find(x=>x.isLamb); const big=s.sheep.find(x=>!x.isLamb); big.state='sleep'; big.stateT=60; big.pose.lie=1; lamb.state='prank'; lamb.prankOn=big; lamb.stateT=6; window._lamb=lamb; window._big=big; return 'lamb charging'})()

(()=>({test:'a lamb barges into a sleeper, which wakes cross and chases it', big:_big.state, at:_big.angryAt===_lamb, lamb:_lamb.state, banner:document.querySelector('.banner')?.textContent, ok: (_big.state==='angry' && _big.angryAt===_lamb) || (_big.rams>0)}))()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const lamb=_lamb; lamb.state='idle'; const w={...s.world, night:true}; let pranks=0; const big=_big; for(let i=0;i<400;i++){ big.state='sleep'; s.toys.forEach(t=>t.chaser=null); lamb.state='idle'; lamb.choose(w); if(lamb.state==='prank') pranks++; lamb.prankOn=null; if(lamb.toy){lamb.toy.chaser=null; lamb.toy=null;} lamb.leaveFood(); lamb.bedtime=false; } lamb.state='idle'; return {test:'lambs pull the prank now and then', rate:+(pranks/400).toFixed(2), ok: pranks/400>0.03 && pranks/400<0.3}})()
